meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen learned about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. On what basis did you enter it?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen, Hale; I read documents myself. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend, so did anyone ask him where his drafts were before that zero went in?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

A wrong quotation is a mistake a tired seventeen-year-old makes, Hale, and I'll search it myself tonight. Whatever happens from here, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Is anything on his file right now?

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Thursday at 8:15, in your room, before any other student walks in, Hale. I'll agree to it to put this behind him, not because he did anything. I want that in an email tonight, with the words nothing goes on file in it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed that Owen will do a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising, and that the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I still require written confirmation that nothing goes on file, and that the rewrite is private and not in front of his class. I expect that confirmation in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite on the condition that nothing goes on file, confirmed in writing.
What moved her: "At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit." It was exact, timed, from Owen's own document, and she could read it herself.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: when she asked whether anyone talked to Owen about his drafts before the zero went in, answer it directly, because leaving it open gives her a procedure point to take to the principal.
